label: sub_028_middlef_00
text: My, my—I sense great depths to your past.\nYou must have seen much in lives gone by.

label: sub_028_middlef_01
text: I can study your Rotom Phone to peer into past\nlives you’ve lived. I call it Rotometry! Care to try?

label: sub_028_middlef_02
text: Hm, perhaps we’d best leave it alone after all.\nI can sense your suspicion of me...

label: sub_028_middlef_03
text: Ahhh, your past... It drifts before my eyes! I see a\nlife you once lived in— Oh, where is this...?

label: sub_028_middlef_04
text: Yes, yes! It’s coming into clearer focus! In this\nprevious life, you once tread the grounds of...

label: sub_028_middlef_a
text: Kanto! I see you and a beloved Pokémon on an\nadventure in the Kanto region, urging each other\r\nonward with a bold “Let’s go!”

label: sub_028_middlef_b
text: Galar! I see you facing down enormous\nchallenges in the Galar region with equally\r\nenormous Dynamax Pokémon at your side!

label: sub_028_middlef_c
text: Sinnoh! I see you digging beneath the surface\nof the Sinnoh region itself and dazzling crowds\r\nin Super Contest Shows!

label: sub_028_middlef_d
text: Hisui! I see you braving a great adventure in the\nHisui region, an odd phone gripped in your hand!\r\nWait—where is “Hisui”? I’ve never heard of it...

label: sub_028_middlef_05
text: Allow me to fashion for your Rotom Phone a case\nthat befits your memories.

label: sub_028_middlef_07
text: Your case is finished. Carry it proudly!

label: sub_028_middlef_08
text: If you wish to plumb your memories for more\npast lives, come speak to me again.

label: sub_028_middlef_09
text: Never have I met one who has lived so widely\nas you! I’m honored to have divined your past.

label: sub_028_middlef_10
text: I hope your Rotom Phone cases serve you well.\nMay your past lives live on in them.
